data.title: Hop Back on the Number Line
data.description: Learn how to subtract numbers by making backward jumps on the number line.

challenges.instruction: Put your finger on the number 6. Hop backward 2 spaces to the left to see where you land!
challenges.hint: Count your backward hops one by one: start at 6 and hop 2 times.

challenges.instruction: Let us start at the number 9 and hop backward 5 spaces to see where we land!
challenges.hint: Put your finger on 9 and count backward hop by hop until you have taken 5 jumps to the left.

challenges.instruction: Put your finger on 3, and hop backward 1 space to the left.
challenges.hint: Start at 3 and count 1 hop backward to see where you land.

challenges.instruction: Ready for your final big hop? Start at 5 and hop backward 5 spaces to see where you land!
challenges.hint: Try placing your finger on 5 and counting backward 5 hops to the left one by one.
